author: SickProdigy
description: Publish new posts from configured X accounts into selected Discord channels using the native X API.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server X account IDs, usernames, destination channel IDs, manager role IDs, polling settings, and last-seen post IDs. It does not store member data. The bot-owner X bearer token is stored separately in Red shared API tokens.
install_msg: The bot owner must configure a native X API bearer token with `[p]set api twitter bearer_token,YOUR_TOKEN`. Server managers can then use `[p]twitterset add #channel username`, `[p]twitterset enabled true`, and `[p]twitterset status`. Native X API reads are billable; review current X pricing before enabling polling.
name: Twitter
